items: Deleting history now stays deleted: removals sync to your other devices and an older synced copy can no longer bring them back (update the sync server to spread deletions between devices).
Android: a new private tab shows your speed dial, with a slim private-tab note at the bottom.
Hide cookie pop-ups: clicks Reject or Only necessary where a banner has it, hides the rest and lets the page scroll again (Privacy settings; desktop and Android).
Desktop: the tab list sections and windows fold away, and recently closed tabs are remembered after a restart.
Desktop: fixed an error when closing a window that was still playing a live stream.
Wallpapers from the internet, sized for your screen or phone: Bing daily, Wikimedia featured photos (with topics) and Picsum.
Every wallpaper you pick or download is kept in a saved list for one-tap switching.
Desktop: theme and wallpaper changes show on open pages straight away, without a refresh.
Desktop: zoom is now per tab instead of shared by every tab of a site.
Android: long-press a link > Open in background tab.
Android: fixed the pull-to-refresh circle that could get stuck on a page.
Google Drive and OneDrive appear in the setup wizard under the sync server options (desktop and Android).
Android: Drive and OneDrive profiles, so one drive can hold several separate sets of data.
Desktop: split view (tiling) is a beta feature again, with its own switch under Beta features.
Desktop: dragging a tab out of the window to make a new one works again.
Google Drive and OneDrive sync, end-to-end encrypted with a passphrase only you know (desktop and Android).
Desktop: tab stacks, tab groups, Rename Tab, bookmarks bar, force dark mode and optional mouse gestures.
Desktop: a sign-in dialog for sites and proxies that ask for a username and password.
